episode_summary: Julia Hurley shares her journey from being voted out of her own company to building a successful real estate brokerage. She provides actionable strategies for lead generation, such as hosting open houses and door knocking, and emphasizes the importance of providing value to high achievers. Julia also discusses her new venture into athlete management and how real estate skills translate into this field.
